title: FIVE SUB APPEARANCES, €40M TALK, AND BARCELONA STILL SAY NO TO BALDE
description:
Linked with two Premier League giants, and yet to start a game this season.

Manchester United and Liverpool are both linked with Barcelona left-back Alejandro Balde. Those two agreeing on anything is rare.

ESPN says a deal could be around €40 million, and Barcelona prefer a permanent sale. Juventus want a loan. But Deco says Barcelona will not sell unless Balde asks to leave.

Goal counts 173 appearances since 2021. This season he has made five, all as a substitute, and has not started any of them. Best seat in the house.

If you were Balde, would you stay and fight for a start or take the move? What is your move?
